cases.cause: Advisory/stale idle status does not establish a current GPU window; a parent-only descriptor does not retain a lease across descendants.

cases.limits: Nonperformance exact capture only; unknown/lowVRAM/hardRAM danger still rejects; foreign processes never signalled.

cases.prevention: Require current queue before+after lock, actualFD dev/inode/FLOCK inheritance, original ACK chain and actual cgroup/PID closure. Never treat prior idle reply as current authority.

cases.fix: Store reader-thread handle; after ACKConsumed wait Native stdinEOF then bounded join before natural return; do not use os._exit.

cases.cause: The producer invokes nvdisasm through its command environment; a tool existing on disk does not prove fixed PATH/NVDISASM resolution in the isolated service.
cases.fix: Pin absoluteNVDISASM and fixedCUDA12.8 PATH plus six exact CLI bytes; offline which/version checks before capture.
cases.limits: Do not infer unsupported workload or repeatGPU until original owned/leases/cgroup close.
cases.observed: CFI a002 actual app returned1 with nvdisasm not found on PATH; a003 exact fixed tool environment captured126 traces exit0.

cases.fix: Use exact local immutable ELF and bounded strict birth join with earliest snapshot and original poll/waitrc; keep original ambiguous failure.
cases.limits: Cause of the original a001 image state remains unproven; do not invent a diagnosis.
cases.observed: Identity failure did not supply a trustworthy app waitrc; absent APPLICATION_START and0B logs alone cannot prove no execution or a birth race.
cases.prevention: Create logs before Popen, persist Popen/wait outcomes, never classify every exe/cmdline read failure as process absence or birth race.

cases.cause: Heavy Native full-future reservation and a bounded capture-control role are different approved resource scopes; systemd CPU declaration alone is not actual sched affinity proof.
cases.fix: Use only Root-exact transport/control role; no Native body/POST/model. Check actual sched affinity, real cgroup limits/membership and current budgets.
cases.limits: Native payload body/POST/hash/model remains forbidden in Role2; separate109 CPU6 service requires its own actual proof.
cases.observed: Root explicitly approved Role2 own2GiB/threeAS512MiB/host67GiB/cg16GiB while keeping full heavy forecast HOLD; actual peer proof checked hard4/swap0/CPU0..7 and inherited slot for all9 members.
cases.prevention: Never label heavy forecast PASS from control-role PASS; never multiply a single service cap by worker count or treat configured AllowedCPUs as observed affinity.

cases.cause: Native /root/share paths and109 NAS aliases are different executable namespaces; lexical mapping order must prefer specific roots.
cases.fix: Stage exact code/small data under the known B private candidate mirror; store both logical Native and physical109 paths bound to the same bytes.
cases.limits: This positive alias proof does not claim all historical path bugs were reproduced by this test.
cases.observed: Exact8 metadata stage reopened64 closed source refs through the existing109 NAS alias, without reading body or creating source aliases.
cases.prevention: Run actual109 metadata smoke through the real front door before service; hash module bytes once and execute those bytes, not unpinned pyc/importloader rereads.

cases.cause: A protected preflight defer is not a captured workload and an exited parent is not positive resource closure.
cases.fix: Use one fresh Root scope per actual launch, original absolute deadline, exact prior-closed exclusion, typed STOP flag, samebytes authority retirement after positive resource closure.
cases.limits: No dynamic qualification from stage metadata; no genericISA/CFI/performance/science grant.
cases.observed: D15 successful first job natural-stopped with original ACK/raw refs and exact22unvisited; D16 pre-GPU defer kept count11 and22pending.
cases.prevention: Join scope/MF/job/owner/pid ticks/ACK bytes/cgroup/kernel locks; preserve old failures and stop-boundary history; keep POST/archive/consumer/science flags separate.

cases.cause: opcode提取保留了无操作数指令末尾分号，错误地将NOP;与NOP比较。
cases.fix: 仅规范化无后续token的单个末尾分号，保留完整SASS和其余静态及动态验证；私有consumer重编后全126输入通过。
cases.observed: Gaussian64原consumer读取完整registry时拒绝NOP;，完整源SASS已经存在。
cases.prevention: 保留真实NOP;正例及NOP;;、NOP; JUNK反例；同格式复用修复，不重采trace。

cases.cause: 读取上限被当作一次预分配长度，与控制进程AS限制冲突。
cases.fix: 在私有模块实例中改为64KiB分块，保留128MiB总上限、原指纹和全部资源规则。
cases.observed: Native控制进程AS128MiB，旧read(128MiB+1)在读取约1.8MB元数据前就MemoryError。
cases.prevention: 用真实AS128运行完整元数据门；不靠提高资源预算掩盖预分配问题。

cases.cause: 服务配置声明被误当作进程实际绑核。
cases.fix: 在原严格检查前显式sched_setaffinity，再检查实际掩码。
cases.observed: SC服务声明AllowedCPUs=0-7后，初始sched_getaffinity未实际收窄，启动前检查失败。
cases.prevention: 记录实际亲和性与cgroup，不能仅验证配置文本。

cases.cause: 私有控制锁误放在NAS并套用了本地POSIX身份假设。
cases.fix: 只将0字节节流控制锁放109受限本地目录，父目录UID1004/0700、锁UID1004/0600；正文和日志仍NAS。
cases.observed: 109创建的NAS控制锁呈现与本地UID1004/0600不同的合成属性，派生在写正文前拒绝。
cases.prevention: 控制锁以实际文件系统和真实fdinfo验收，不放宽为信任任意NAS owner或0777。

cases.cause: 读取端未在既有新鲜期限内对短暂缺失进行有界重读；ENOENT本身不能证明Native租约已释放。
cases.fix: 新候选仅对ENOENT及JSON读取竞争总计不超过2秒重读；每次仍核scope、run和20秒新鲜期限，持续缺失或身份不符失败。
cases.observed: SC已闭合472项后，读取心跳文件一次ENOENT即退出，已完成项保留。
cases.prevention: 为心跳读取竞争保留有限恢复；按已闭合清单采用原结果，不重做472。新候选的部署及实际续跑另看回执。

cases.cause: 按文本子串替换容量表达式，连带改动16*G。
cases.fix: 保留原执行和12GiB事实，单独更正16GiB模块；Root仅接受已有功能结果，不授全程16GiB资源合规资格。
cases.observed: model2容量机械替换误将16GiB物理余量改为12GiB。原实际功能回放通过，但不能声称全程执行了16GiB门。
cases.prevention: 按语法节点或精确表达式改容量，实测边界并保存实际快照；不可用配置声明覆盖运行事实。

cases.cause: Direct exclusive creation exposes a directory entry before JSON contents finish.
cases.fix: Publish closed/fsynced temporary JSON atomically without overwrite; only ENOENT/JSONDecode get a bounded reread, scope/hash remains exact.
cases.limits: Does not relax malformed, wrong identity or stale authority.
cases.observed: Closed handshake file could be momentarily visible empty and ACK consumption failed; old failures retained.
cases.prevention: Use actual concurrent reader/writer tests; ACK existence alone is not closure.

cases.cause: OpenSSH process startup closes inherited nonstandard FDs.
cases.fix: Nonexec Python relay retains real four lease FDs, waits true SSH result and independent exact remote closure before closing them.
cases.limits: Parent/subprocess intent or pass_fds argument alone does not prove lease lifetime.
cases.observed: Actual SSH child dropped/reused passed FDs; four private fixture locks became available while remote work remained live.
cases.prevention: Real SSH lifecycle test must close parent copies and verify actual kernel locks remain until remote closure.

cases.cause: Whole pointer rawSHA CAS included observational timestamp alongside immutable identity.
cases.fix: Compare complete pointer keyset and every non-time value; ignore only explicitly named timestamp values while immutable versions/catalog contents remain exact.
cases.limits: No ignored identity/path/version/count/schema fields and no weakening immutable manifestSHA.
cases.observed: A cooperating catalog writer refreshed only CURRENT timestamp during an unchanged immutable47-version interval, rejecting publication before relocation.
cases.prevention: Preserve old catalog entries, real new COMMIT, exact versionSHA, actual same-lock publication and postpublish readback.
